title: Tomato growing and support
summary: Manage transplanting, support, watering and disease observation for tomatoes.
steps: Use healthy hardened plants or start seed early enough for the local warm season.
Plant after damaging cold risk, with adequate root volume and immediate stake, cage or trellis support.
Water deeply and consistently at soil level; large wet-dry swings can damage fruit and roots.
Maintain airflow, remove leaves touching soil when appropriate and disinfect tools between suspect plants.
Harvest at the intended ripeness and remove fallen or diseased fruit promptly.
